points.quote: is AFFiNE's window manager. It covers the main area and the right sidebar.
`entities/workbench.ts` holds the list of views (`views$`)... **View** (`entities/view.ts`) is one managed window, like a tab or split pane.
its own history, built on an in-memory navigable history... a `location$` LiveData that mirrors that history's listener
It creates a per-view `createMemoryRouter(routes)`, using the routes from `router.tsx`... The matched route component renders the page.
It renders `<ViewHeader>`, `<ViewBody>` and `<ViewSidebarTab tabId icon>`... The workbench layout places matching `ViewHeaderTarget`, `ViewBodyTarget` and `ViewSidebarTabBodyTarget` components.
The active view's URL counts as the URL of the whole app.
Only the active view's sidebar is shown... If a view has several tabs, a header switcher appears.
PUSH and REPLACE on the view history are mirrored to the browser... A browser location change is pushed into the view history as `fromBrowser`.
